verdict.rationale: Sumsub's own docs claim verification of 14,000+ document types from 220+ countries and territories, and say verification levels can include document-based checks. That establishes a documented coverage breadth, but the pack never names the specific document types or shows a published supported-country/document list. missing for 10: a published supported-documents/countries list, explicit coverage of passports, national IDs, driver licenses and residence permits, independent or hands-on corroboration of the coverage claim.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the platform verifies government IDs from a documented breadth of countries and document types — passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits — with the supported list published

citations.quote: Instantly verify 14,000+ document types from 220+ countries and territories.
Each level may include document-based or selfie-based verification
